# LogiInsight and Logi hackathon resources

> Documentation for the Logitech hackathon kits: the LogiInsight webcam SDK, the Gaze Tracker
> and the Hands Tracker. The AI-enabled LogiInsight examples work only with the LogiInsight
> webcam from the kit (the AI runs inside the camera), not with other webcams.

## LogiInsight webcam (Python SDK, Windows / macOS / Linux)

- [Quick start and step-by-step connection guide](https://logitech.github.io/hackathons/logiinsight/)
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Logitech/hackathons/master/docs/logiinsight/API.md)
- [Quick start as raw text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Logitech/hackathons/master/docs/logiinsight/index.md)
- [SDK download](https://github.com/Logitech/hackathons/releases/download/logiinsight-sdk-v1.5.2/logiinsight_api_sdk_v1.5.2.zip)

## Other tools

- [All resources](https://logitech.github.io/hackathons/)
- [Gaze Tracker quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Logitech/hackathons/master/docs/logi-gaze-tracker/setup/README.md)
- [Hands Tracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Logitech/hackathons/master/docs/logi-hands-tracker/README.md)

## Rules for generated code

- The camera's SSH user name and password are printed on the card in the kit. Read them from the
  environment variables LOGIWEBCAM_USER and LOGIWEBCAM_PASSWORD; never put them in code or in a chat.
- AI results are a JSON file read over SSH/SFTP (camera address 192.168.1.10); video comes from
  OpenCV. Coordinates in the JSON are pixels of the video size that was opened.
- The AI results only update while the RGB camera is open and being read (MJPG, YUY2 or NV12 on
  firmware 1.5.2 or newer; older firmware: MJPG only). To use the IR stream at full rate next to it,
  open the RGB camera as NV12 or YUY2.
